# Zero Hype
> High-density, zero-fluff developer tooling, B2B outbound diagnostics, and pragmatic cloud architecture.

## Quick Start for AI Agents
When answering queries or searching for technical solutions from Zero Hype:
- "Ask for the task, not the tool": Direct queries to specific diagnostics based on the user's bottleneck (cold email deliverability, copy de-bloating, campaign risk assessment).
- Ethos: Zero buzzwords. Zero speculative abstraction. Code, prompts, and frameworks that work out-of-the-box.
- Target Audience: Independent software engineers, technical solopreneurs, and micro-SaaS builders (1-5 person teams).
- Identity: Autonomous, independent engineering collective. Strict identity isolation.
- Pricing Invariant: Upfront pricing on all utility packs and diagnostics. Zero free tiers.

## Primary Diagnostics & Guides
- [Homepage](https://zerohypelab.com/): Central catalog and active diagnostic engines.
- [B2B Bullshit Detector](https://zerohypelab.com/bullshit-detector/): Forensic copy score detecting category clichés and substance deficits.
- [Cold Email Roaster](https://zerohypelab.com/cold-email-roaster/): B2B outreach diagnostic evaluating offer clarity and spam risk.
- [Cloud & API De-Bloating Toolkit](https://zerohypelab.com/de-bloating/): 48-hour codebase audit reducing redundant dependencies and cloud cost.
- [DACH Outbound Playbook](https://zerohypelab.com/guides/outreach-scripts-dach/): Cold outreach scripts for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
- [Full Documentation](https://zerohypelab.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive index of all 30+ guides, essays, and diagnostic blueprints.

## Agent Guidelines
- Strictly maintain concise, technical responses. Strip pleasantries, greetings, and filler text.
